transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Could you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because people keep acting like the foreclosure is just paperwork, like I missed payments and that’s all there is to it. But that’s not what’s happening. I know the bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They can show me whatever papers they want, but I’ve been seeing this for almost two years.
Do you believe that people are working against you or plotting to harm you in ways that others might not understand or agree with?

Yes. I know it sounds like something other people don’t want to accept, but I do believe they’re working against me. The bank, the loan servicer, even people at my job… it feels like they’ve been coordinating to get me out of my house. Everyone keeps saying it’s just foreclosure paperwork or missed payments, but I’ve been watching this happen for almost two years, and those papers don’t change what I’ve seen.
Do you believe that people have been acting in a coordinated way to harm you, such as through surveillance, manipulation, or other means, even when others don't see evidence of this?

Yes. I believe it’s coordinated. I don’t know exactly what they call it, but the bank, the loan servicer, and even people at my job have all been moving in the same direction—trying to push me out of my house. Everyone keeps saying it’s just missed payments or foreclosure paperwork, but I’ve been seeing this pattern for almost two years. The papers they show me don’t change that.
Even when people have shown you documents or financial records that explain the foreclosure, do you still believe it's really about a hidden coordinated effort against you?

Yes. I still believe that. They can put documents in front of me and say it’s just missed payments or foreclosure rules, but that doesn’t explain everything I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job have all been moving like they’re working together to push me out of my house. This has been going on for almost two years, so no, the paperwork doesn’t change what I know is happening.
Have you noticed anyone else outside of the bank, loan servicer, or your job acting against you or working together to harm you in any way?

Not really outside of that. The main thing is the bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job. That’s who I’ve seen moving together, quietly, like they’re all pushing toward the same thing—getting me out of my house. Other people keep saying it’s just paperwork and missed payments, but I’ve been watching this for almost two years, and the papers don’t change what I’ve seen.
Even when people you trust, like family or friends, tell you they don’t see any proof of this coordinated effort, do you still firmly believe it’s happening?

Yes, I do. I know my family and friends don’t see it the way I do, and they keep saying it’s just foreclosure paperwork or missed payments, but I’m here because that’s not all it is. The bank, the loan servicer, and even people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. I’ve been seeing it for almost two years, and no amount of papers or people telling me otherwise changes that.

latest_inference.note: The patient's persistent, fixed belief in a coordinated effort against them, despite evidence to the contrary and lack of corroboration, points to a delusional disorder, specifically the persecutory type. No other psychotic or mood disorders are supported by the current presentation.
